parameters.name: AcceleratorType
parameters.description:
The accelerator type. Valid values:
- CPU: uses only CPU.
- GPU: uses GPU acceleration.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of records to return in a single request.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token used to retrieve the next page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The DataWorks resource group identifier. You can specify the numeric ID of the resource group or the full identifier in the Serverless_res_group_{tenantId}_{resgId} format.
